controls.name: clean identity / no-loss delivery
controls.role: Task-matched identity control; valid content is bit-exact and SI-SDR is undefined with reason exact_reconstruction, never invented.

controls.name: zero-fill and hold baselines
controls.role: Degraded/adverse controls on the same erasure masks; the 12-clip screen found zero fill competitive on SI-SDR, so no method is assumed superior.

controls.name: linear interpolation baseline
controls.role: Established task-matched waveform baseline bridging the last good sample to the next good frame.

controls.name: pitch-period repetition
controls.role: Causal extrapolation control that repeats a detected period with decay; explicit zero-fill fallback when unvoiced or silent.

controls.name: autoregressive prediction
controls.role: Causal all-pole forward-prediction control with explicit fallback and clamped-sample accounting.

controls.name: synthetic decoder-PLC-style surrogate
controls.role: Waveform surrogate with fixed decay gains; deliberately not Opus, DRED, Lyra or any codec runtime.

controls.name: admission and adverse rejection envelope
controls.role: Missing, short, wrong-shape, zero-length, nonfinite, bad-padding, stale-epoch, duplicate, out-of-order, future, after-final and over-burst frames are rejected without changing stream state.

controls.name: single-erasure XOR parity and explicit multi-erasure failure
controls.role: Redundancy-assisted control: a single packet is recovered with its original timestamp; a two-packet burst is rejected rather than guessed.

controls.name: concealed-slot validity accounting
controls.role: Concealed output slots carry result flag 4 and valid_count=0 and are excluded from valid content and sample conservation.

controls.name: supplied erasure mask and packet timeline
controls.role: Every local cohort supplies the exact loss mask; loss detection from arrivals, late packets or redundancy is untested.
